attrs.note: datasheet - the material (PVC rated UL 94V-0), the standards (ANSI/TIA 568, cULus listed), the covers and the accessories are the specification sheet's.

capacity.note: datasheet - Leviton's application note "Maximum Cable Fill Ratios in Cable Managers" (NS-AN-23-006-05-30-23, 5/30/2023). Front: page 15, "1RU Horizontal Cable Manager 3.1 sq.in. (491RU-HFR, -HFO)" and, for the 6AS10 patch cord (0.240 in), 34 cords at 50 percent fill, 20 at 30 percent (the "recommended practical maximum" for patch cords in front managers), 17 at 25 percent. Rear: page 7, "Rear Channel of 1RU Front/Rear Horizontal Duct 491RU-HFR 1.125 in x 3.75 in 4.2 sq.in." and page 8, for a 0.240 in cable, 23 at 25 percent and 32 at 35 percent (the practical maximum for cable in rear managers). The cords and cables are named by Leviton part number or outer diameter and not by category, so no `cable-capacity-media` is stated.

chassis.note: drawing - 444.5 x 47.9 x 254.95. The plate is 18.9974 in [482.53mm] wide over its ears and 1.8865 in [47.9mm] high, which is 3.5 mm more than a rack unit; the body between its ears is the 444.5 from 18.85 to 463.35 on the top view (17.50 in on the specification sheet), which this library draws and not the ears. The 254.95 is the drawing's 10.038 in overall: 83.97 from the front to the ear plane, then the rear 171.

color.note: estimated - the specification sheet sells the ducts "with black covers" and names no colour for the duct; every drawing is line work, so the whole is this library's render of black PVC. The product page states no colour.

cover.note: datasheet - both covers ship fitted: the specification sheet lists the duct "with black covers" and calls them "snap-on duct cover"; the instruction sheet (Versi-Duct Slotted Duct System, horizontal slotted duct, step 2) says to fit the cover over the top of the duct fingers, push down and rotate it to the other side until it snaps into place. They are drawn fitted in `base` and absent in `cover-off`. A hinge for each (49265-HNG, "Duct Cover Hinge", at least two to a cover) is a separate accessory.

ears.note: drawing - `positions` states where the ears bolt, for the Rack Builder. The ears are the flat ends of the mounting plate: the top view of the 491RU-HFR dimensional drawing dimensions 3.306 in [83.97mm] from the front of the cover to the back of the plate, and the front channel stands in front of it, the rear channel and the section joining it behind it, 171 mm of the 254.95. `at` is 83.97, so the part spans the rail. This states a placement; no dimension changed.

front.note: drawing - the front channel with its cover fitted: 1.5 in [38.1mm] high over its walls (4.91 to 43.01), centred on the 47.9 plate, and 1.886 in [47.9mm] over the cover and finger tips. The channel's clear size is 1.125 in x 2.75 in [28.58 x 69.85mm], 3.1 sq in, in Leviton's application note (page 15).

full-depth.note: `full-depth: false` - the front channel stands 83.97 mm in front of the plane of the ears and the rear channel 171 behind it (the top view, 254.95 overall), so it serves the face it is bolted to and the space just behind the rails; at 171 mm it does not reach the rear rails of a rack, and the rear face of its rack unit stays free for another part.

guides.note: drawing - each duct is the channel between its two finger walls, run across the rack; finger pitch (49.375) and slot gap (22.45) are the top view figures above, and each size is the clear height Leviton's application note gives (28.58 mm both).

left.note: drawing - an elevation, the drawing's side view: the front channel and its cover, the plate, the section joining it to the rear channel (its two sloped sheets run 38.1 apart at the rear channel and 43.8 at the plate, drawn as flat strips) and the rear channel and its cover. The right is the same, turned round.

method.note: FIGURES FROM THE MAKER'S OWN DIMENSIONAL DRAWING. Leviton publishes the 491RU-HFR drawing as DXF and DWG on its product page; the DXF is vector CAD in inches with five views, with the dimensions 18.9974 in, 17.5 in, 1.8865 in, 3.306 in and 6.7316 in. The assembly in the drawing includes the covers ("w/ cover"). Every figure here is read from its line work at 25.4 mm to the inch: the side view's outline gives each channel's height (1.5 in over both walls, the covers and finger tips 1.886 in), the top view the slots, the plate and the ovals. This drawing's top view is drawn with the rear at the bottom; the figures are turned to the front-first order of the 492RU-HFR, whose slots, ovals and covers it repeats. THE SPECIFICATION SHEET AND THE DRAWING AGREE on the channels' nominal sizes (1.5 x 3 in front, 1.5 x 4 in rear), and the application note's usable sizes are smaller (1.125 x 2.75 in and 1.125 x 3.75 in).

passes.note: drawing - the four oval holes in the top of the section and the four in its bottom, as the drawing draws them in its top and bottom views: 75.88 x 38.15 mm, through the section into the hollow between the plate and the rear channel. Their places are the 492RU-HFR's: the drawing's panel lines (22.85, 128.45, 133.0, 238.6, 243.15, 348.75, 353.3 and 458.9) repeat its own. A cable laid over the duct can be put through one into the hollow and out of the opposite hole to the other side. Open: no document says the holes are closed.

rear.note: drawing - the rear channel with its cover fitted: 1.5 in [38.1mm] high over its walls, centred on the plate, and 1.886 in [47.9mm] over the cover and finger tips; the back of the plate and the section round it. The channel's clear size is 1.125 in x 3.75 in [28.58 x 95.25mm], 4.2 sq in, in the application note (page 7).

thickness.note: drawing - the walls of the fingers are 2.54 mm [0.1 in] on the side view (4.91 to 7.45 and 40.47 to 43.01 for both channels) and the plate 3.04.

top.note: drawing - an elevation, rear at the top of the drawing: the rear cover over the rear 22.8 mm, the rear finger wall and its nine slots from 23.1 mm in to the base of the channel, the section with its four oval holes (75.88 x 38.15 mm, 110.2 apart), the plate, then the front finger wall with the same nine slots and the front cover over the front 22.8 mm. The slots are those of the 492RU-HFR, which this drawing draws at the same places. The bottom is the same from underneath.

weight.note: no document states a weight: the specification sheet, the product page and the instruction sheet are silent. `weight-kg` is left out and a gap says so.
